route: Medical withdrawal and current suicide-risk screen.
Assess alcohol history, withdrawal symptoms, sedative use, other substances, seizures/delirium risk, and access to care.
Use urgent medical evaluation when withdrawal risk warrants it.
Only after medical safety, support sleep, relapse prevention, and emotional coping.
